# Completion guidance for an appointment by office

This explanatory sheet explains how to distinguish a role description from the name of the person who is to act. The blank instrument must be completed from instructions before it is signed.

1. State whether the appointment concerns a particular individual or an office holder. A description such as “the accountant” must not be treated as a personal name. If the intention is to appoint an individual, obtain and record that person's name in the completed instrument.
2. Describe the permitted acts. Authority to inspect an account does not automatically authorise borrowing, disposal of property or acceptance of a disputed charge.
3. Explain how a replacement becomes entitled to act. The mere appearance of a replacement field on a form does not activate an appointment. The triggering event must be identified in the signed instructions.

The proposed signing date of 20 January 2027 is illustrative. The amount of GBP 50 is an example of an expense limit. Section 6.2, article 11 and schedule 1 apply.

No signature is required on this explanatory sheet.
